steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each return and cost is matched to its assumption and source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Risk with no mitigation
findings.fix: Name a mitigation and its owner

findings.title: Return with no stated assumption
findings.fix: State the assumption and its source

findings.title: Cost line not matching the brief
findings.fix: Reconcile the cost to the brief

prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-campaign-proposal skill on the records for this review.
